title: Describe a teenager you know who has an unusual hobby.
bullets: how you came to know about it
explain: and explain why people around them react the way they do to this hobby.
followUps: Would you like to try an unusual hobby yourself?
p3: What do most teenagers in your country tend to do in their free time?
How do parents usually respond when their children take up an unusual interest?
Are young people today more or less likely to pursue niche hobbies than their parents were?
What are the advantages of a hobby that most of one's friends do not share?
Could online communities make unusual interests more acceptable for young people in future?
Does a child's choice of hobby say much about their character in later life?

title: Describe a person whose job you think is very important.
bullets: how their work affects other people
explain: and explain why you think their job is so important.
followUps: Have you ever thanked someone for work most people overlook?
p3: Which kinds of jobs do people in your country tend to respect the most?
Why do some essential jobs receive far less pay than others?
How could society show more appreciation for the people who keep public services running?
What makes a job feel meaningful to the person doing it?
How has the status of skilled trades changed over the last few decades?
Will automation change which essential jobs society values most in the future?

title: Describe a person you looked up to when you were a child.
bullets: how you first came across them
what it was about them that impressed you
explain: and explain how this person influenced the way you behaved.
followUps: Do you still admire them today?
p3: What kinds of people do children tend to admire most when they are growing up?
Are children today more likely to look up to celebrities than to people they know personally?
In what ways do parents shape the heroes their children choose?
Is it healthy for a child to build their sense of self around one admired adult?
Could the influence of online personalities ever match that of a trusted family friend?
How much of an adult's character can be traced back to the figures they admired as children?

title: Describe a modern building you find interesting.
bullets: what it looks like from outside
explain: and explain why it stands out from the buildings around it.
followUps: Would you like to live or work in a building like this?
p3: What kinds of new buildings are most common in big cities today?

How does a modern design compare with an older building in terms of comfort?
Which materials make the greatest difference to a modern building's performance?
Is modern architecture changing the character of historic towns for better or worse?
How might cities look in fifty years if they continue to grow upwards rather than outwards?

title: Describe a place in your town that you would like to see improved.
bullets: what it looks like at the moment
explain: and explain why it needs attention from local people.
followUps: Has anyone in your area tried to make this change?
p3Topics: Who decides what a town looks like
p3: What kinds of public spaces do people value most in their local area?
How do local councils decide which places receive money for improvements?
Why are some town centres more attractive to visitors than others?
Is it more effective to build new facilities or to maintain existing ones?
Will town centres in future be designed more for people than for cars?
How much influence should residents have over changes to their own streets?

bullets: where the cinema or theatre is
what kinds of shows it has
explain: and explain what keeps you coming back.

Why do live performances often feel more memorable than recorded ones?
How important is it for a city to have a good theatre for its cultural life?

title: Describe a bag or wallet you use every day.
bullets: what kind of bag or wallet it is
what you usually keep in it
explain: and explain why it has become so important to you.

p3: What do most people in your country look for when they buy a bag?
Why do some people spend far more on a wallet than they actually need?

title: Describe something second-hand that you bought.
explain: and explain how you decided to buy it.

Do you think used items are as good as new ones?

Is buying second-hand cheaper than buying new in most cases?

title: Describe a piece of technology from your childhood that is now out of date.
explain: and explain why you still think about it.

title: Describe a prize-giving or graduation ceremony you attended.
explain: and explain how the occasion made the people there feel.

title: Describe a talk or lecture you attended that interested you.
bullets: how the speaker presented the material
explain: and explain what made it stay with you after the event.

title: Describe a time when you received excellent service in a shop or restaurant.
